classification.rationale: Public media interview transcript featuring witness testimony about government hacking and UFO claims. No classification marks, no custody issues. Suitable for ingestion.

_raw_list: I was just a guy, normal guy interested in UFOs. Happened to have some IT skills. Nothing genius level.
I wrote a Pearl script ... that I could run across thousands of machines in minutes and find blank passwords or passwords that were either blank or password admin.

When I double clicked this... slowly a hemisphere started appearing and I'm thinking that's a planet... then suddenly there's a big straight kind of silvery line, cigar-shaped object. I see the mouse move... They right clicked, disconnect, and boom, that was it. I was cut out.
This spreadsheet was titled non-terrestrial officers... That was incredible.
I had one very strange experience... I was suddenly woken up by a really sharp pain... in my left heel. There were two perfectly circular holes.
I'm on the pole red list. (Interpol Red Notice)
I never found anything to do with Solar Warden... there's no evidence for Solar Warden and I have nothing to do with it.
I used a site ... Nihei's IP index ... I could just grab a block, plug it into my script, and scan like a quarter of a million computers in 8 minutes.
The redacting they did on PDFs back then was not fully redacted. You could unredact it once you downloaded the file to your own PC.
On one site I found the jailer's file. ... guys taking LSD that work on submarines.
